Lucide icon sources

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/a79b2d131dab2bf20cb224bd0937b439a9c4fa99

SVG files are unmodified upstream assets. License: ISC, with the included Feather MIT notice for derived icons. The plugin embeds these assets and recolours currentColor to the OBS palette. Filled shapes add a fill. Ellipse variants and Player Ring vertically scale Circle/Circle Dashed.
